projects.title: Library Test Coverage Course Project
bullets: Wrote unit tests for utility functions using Python and pytest in a supervised undergraduate course project on small open-source libraries.
Measured branch coverage and documented test failures and fixes while examining test coverage in the course project's small open-source libraries.

research.title: Public Data Query Performance
bullets: Loaded public tables into a SQLite relational database as a student research assistant contributing to supervised faculty research on query performance.
Wrote aggregation and join queries using SQL and documented query plans for the supervised investigation of performance on public tabular data.
